integration_removed.description:
The TP-Link LTE integration has been removed from Universal Universal Home Assistant.

The integration has not been working since Universal Universal Home Assistant 2023.6.0, has no maintainer, and its underlying library depends on a package with a [critical security vulnerability]({ghsa_url}).

To resolve this issue, remove the `tplink_lte` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Universal Universal Home Assistant.
integration_removed.title: The TP-Link LTE integration has been removed
